hints.title: Merge two at a time
hints.body: Merging two sorted arrays is a linear two-pointer scan.

hints.title: Divide and conquer
hints.body: Pair up the arrays and merge each pair, then repeat on the results.

hints.title: Fewer passes
hints.body: Each value participates in `O(log k)` merges, giving `O(N log k)` total work.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
while more than one array remains:
    next round = []
    for each adjacent pair:
        next round.append(merge two arrays)
    arrays = next round
return the only array, or [] if there were none
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
